headline: Rivian Acquires Third Dimension AI to Enhance Autonomous Driving
summary: Electric vehicle maker Rivian has acquired Third Dimension AI to bolster its autonomous driving technology capabilities.
why: Automakers are heavily investing in artificial intelligence and machine learning acquisitions to compete in advanced driver-assistance systems and autonomous vehicle development.

impacts.name: Rivian Automotive
impacts.why: Integrating new AI software can accelerate technological roadmaps but requires capital outlays.
